input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: "Client" is defined as Mortgage Logic.com, Inc. alone (p0003), so the § 2(a) grant reaches neither Client's affiliates nor contractors, and there is no notice mechanic to add affiliates. Section 15 (p0080) bars any transfer of rights without TrueLink's prior written approval, with the only exception being an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate, so the licence is not transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction. Both fallback elements therefore fail. We target the fallback: affiliates covered on written notice in the grant, and a Client-only carve-out from the assignment consent for transfer of the licence to an M&A successor (drafted as an exception rather than a "notwithstanding" override, to avoid conflict with the retained consent mechanic). We have not pressed the preferred perpetual/irrevocable and contractor points, given the subscription-style term in § 2(c).

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client affiliates on written notice and permit transfer to an M&A successor
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The licence runs to Client alone and any transfer needs TrueLink's approval, so we extend the grant to Client's affiliates on written notice and carve Client's transfer of the licence to an M&A successor out of the assignment consent. This is our fallback licence-scope position.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client and, upon written notice to TrueLink, its affiliates a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business

ops.oldText: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or for Client's transfer of the license to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
